name: Bat spawns (various)
accessNote: Bats (level 6) and Giant bats (level 27) are common at low-density spots across Kandarin and Morytania; Giant bats also spawn in Arceuus near the Dark Altar. There is no single canonical bat location, so multi, cannon and safespot are conservative defaults and not wiki-confirmed for one spot. Some spots border the Wilderness, but a non-Wilderness spot is the safe default.
